Override.AttributionNote: 五燈會元續略. Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Fozhi Duanyu (佛智禪師語錄), Guyun Quan section. Guyun Quan is the exact hall speaker who raises Xuefeng and Zhaozhou's answers on the ancient ravine's cold spring and says that one follows the waves and chases the currents while the other cuts off the many streams.
